facts.fact: So They Can says the Onekana Digital Attendance App is in use in its 10 partner primary schools in Baringo.
So They Can says teachers use the Onekana app to capture daily attendance per child at the school, linked to NEMIS.
So They Can says 1,600 children across 10 partner primary schools in Baringo will be registered in the app with daily attendance recorded.
